sources.name: KBO/BCE Public Search (Crossroads Bank for Enterprises)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. Official FPS Economy public search over all registered entities (enterprise number, name, activity NACE, address); server-rendered HTML, parseable.

sources.name: KBO/BCE Open Data — full + update downloads
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. Daily full-file and update-file CSV ZIPs of all active registered entities/establishments; free after registration; SFTP delivery available (kbo-bce-webservice@economie.fgov.be); cookbook PDF documents the schema. This is the backbone entity source for Belgium.

sources.name: NBB Central Balance Sheet Office — Consult (annual accounts viewer)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED to exist (SPA loads titled 'Consult'). Free public consultation of ~500k filed annual accounts per year; the app itself is a JS SPA — machine route is the CBSO REST API, not this UI.

sources.name: NBB CBSO Webservices (REST API for filings)
sources.verdict: Search-verified (page + technical guide PDF found). REST API exposing filed annual accounts in XBRL, JSON and PDF; API keys managed via CBSO Developer Portal. The deterministic route to Belgian company financials.

sources.name: NBB.Stat — statistics from annual accounts
sources.verdict: Search-verified. Aggregated annual-accounts statistics via NBB.Stat (SDMX-style stats portal). Fetch of exact stats endpoints not attempted; page URL from official NBB site listing.

sources.name: FSMA — UCITS & AIFM management companies lists
sources.verdict: URL search-verified (appears in Google-indexed FSMA pages) but fsma.be resets all automated fetches (ECONNRESET) — crawl will need browser-grade fetching. Links to the official lists of Belgian and EEA-passported ManCos/AIFMs, mostly as PDFs.

sources.name: FSMA — list of Belgian AIFMs (PDF)
sources.verdict: URL search-verified (indexed FSMA replacement_files PDF, 'Beheerders van alternatieve instellingen voor collectieve belegging naar Belgisch recht'). PDF list — parse with a deterministic PDF parser; fsma.be blocks our fetcher so freshness must be checked at crawl time.

sources.name: FSMA — list of EEA AIFMs passported into Belgium (PDF)
sources.verdict: URL search-verified (indexed FSMA PDF). Companion list of EEA AIFM passport notifications — maps which foreign GPs market into Belgium.

sources.name: FSMA — authorized IORPs (pension funds) list
sources.verdict: URL search-verified ('Vergunde instellingen voor bedrijfspensioenvoorziening naar Belgisch recht'). 148 Belgian-law IORPs (€48.9bn assets end-2024) — the core Belgian LP register. fsma.be blocks automated fetch.

sources.name: FSMA — Crypto-Asset Service Providers (MiCA CASP register)
sources.verdict: URL search-verified. FSMA is Belgium's CASP licensing authority since MiCA (transition ended 1 Jul 2026); it maintains the authorized-CASP register plus a fraudulent-CASP warning list. Site blocks automated fetch.

sources.name: NBB — search for a financial institution (all supervised lists)
sources.verdict: Search-verified official NBB page for searching lists of institutions authorised/supervised by NBB (banks, insurers, stockbroking firms, payment institutions). Exact page not fetched (guessed NBB subpaths 404 elsewhere, so verify path at crawl time).

sources.name: NBB — lists of credit institutions
sources.verdict: Search-verified (indexed NBB page 'Lists'). Official lists of Belgian credit institutions and EEA branches; NBB pages are server-rendered and generally parseable.

sources.name: NBB — payment institutions & e-money institutions
sources.verdict: Search-verified indexed NBB page. Rounds out the specialty-finance perimeter (payment/EMI licensees).

sources.name: Belgian Greenhouse Gas Registry (EU ETS national administrator)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. Federal Climate Change Department administers ~360 installation/aircraft accounts + 30 trading accounts in the Union Registry (CSEUR). Static, parseable site; account-holder detail lives in EU Union Registry public reports.

sources.name: Belgisch Staatsblad / Moniteur belge (official gazette)
sources.verdict: Search-verified official gazette portal (laws, decrees, notices). Old-school CGI pages, fully server-rendered and parseable; daily editions.

sources.name: Staatsblad — Rechtspersonen annex (company deeds & publications)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. All acts of legal entities since 1 Jul 2003 (incorporations, mergers, director appointments/removals, dissolutions) — searchable by enterprise number; PDFs of deeds. Key event stream for Belgian entities.

sources.name: RegSol — Central Register of Solvency (insolvency files)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. All bankruptcy and judicial-reorganisation files since 2017 for all enterprise courts. Consultation is free but gated: an interested party must request access to a file; no open bulk route. Pair with Statbel bankruptcy stats and Staatsblad publications for the machine-readable signal.

sources.name: JUPORTAL — Belgian public case-law database
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. Official public database of Belgian case law (Cassation, Constitutional Court, Council of State etc.), ECLI-indexed; replaced Jure-Juridat in 2020.

sources.name: Euronext Brussels — equities list
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch: page exists with filters (BEL20, regulated, Growth, Access, Expert market) but the issuer table is dynamically loaded — needs the underlying JSON endpoints or headless render. Covers listed GPs (Gimv, Sofina, Brederode, GBL) and REITs (SIR/GVV).

sources.name: Private Capital Belgium (formerly BVA) — member directory
sources.verdict: VERIFIED to exist: bva.be/the-members/ 301-redirects here; our fetcher gets 403 (WAF). Association rebranded from BVA; ~42 fund members + ~43 associate members (service providers) per search evidence. The canonical Belgian GP roster.

sources.name: Febelfin — member list (Excel download)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. ~245 member institutions (banks, credit providers, asset managers, brokers, leasing companies) with a public .xlsx member list linked from the page — rare clean bulk association roster.

sources.name: BEAMA — Belgian Asset Managers Association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. ~100 members; publishes quarterly Belgian fund-sector statistics and monthly core figures — both an entity roster and a market-size series.

sources.name: Assuralia — Belgian insurance federation
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. Sector federation with studies/statistics per insurance branch; member list not shown on homepage — insurer roster better taken from NBB supervised lists.

sources.name: PensioPlus — pension fund association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. Represents Belgian IORPs and sector pension organisers (2.66m members, €48.9bn AUM, 123% funding ratio); no public member list — use FSMA IORP register for the roster.

sources.name: UPSI-BVS — real estate developers association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. Professional association of Belgian property developers with public directory of working + supporting members (Befimmo, Atenor, Thomas & Piron visible) — feeds Real Assets coverage.

sources.name: SFPIM/FPIM — federal investment company portfolio
sources.verdict: Search-verified (indexed 'Investment portfolio (30/06/2025)' pages on sfpim.be). Federal holding with 130+ portfolio positions — a major Belgian LP/direct investor.

sources.name: PMV — Flemish investment company
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. Flemish public investment company (startups, scale-ups, SME loans, real estate, infrastructure, clean tech, life sciences); has a Portfolio section and publications.

sources.name: Wallonie Entreprendre — Walloon investment company
sources.verdict: Search-verified (news pages fetched in SERPs; merger of SRIW/Sowalfin/Sogepa). Walloon public investor and fund-of-funds LP; homepage itself not fetched.

sources.name: finance&invest.brussels — Brussels regional investment company
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. Brussels regional investment company (ex-SRIB) with news/portfolio case studies; third leg of the regional public-capital triangle.

sources.name: e-Procurement Belgium (BOSA / publicprocurement.be)
sources.verdict: Search-verified. Free federal platform where all Belgian public tenders publish (e-Notification since 2011, eForms metadata-driven); above-threshold notices forward to TED. Exact bulk/open-data endpoint to be confirmed at crawl time.

sources.name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (Belgian notices)
sources.verdict: Well-known EU publication portal; Belgian above-threshold notices flow here and are available via the public TED API / bulk XML — the clean machine route for BE procurement signals (EPC contractors, concessionaires, infra).

sources.name: IBR-IRE — public register of statutory auditors
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. Searchable official register of bedrijfsrevisoren (auditors, firms, networks, third-country auditors) with individual register numbers — fund-auditor leg of the service graph.

sources.name: ITAA — Institute for Tax Advisors and Accountants
sources.verdict: Only search-verified as the professional institute (via IFAC/Accountancy Europe references); the public member-search route was not verified — confirm before relying on it.

sources.name: Advocaat.be — find-a-lawyer (Orde van Vlaamse Balies)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. Official public directory of Flemish-bar lawyers, filterable by practice area (insolvency, M&A, real estate) and location.

sources.name: Avocats.be — French/German-speaking bars directory
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. OBFG site with 'Trouver votre avocat(e)' public search by bar, specialty; completes national lawyer coverage.

sources.name: Statbel Open Data (bankruptcies, enterprise demography)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. CC BY 4.0 open datasets incl. weekly and monthly bankruptcy statistics and enterprise data — the machine-readable distress-signal series.

sources.name: data.gov.be — Belgian national open data portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED by fetch. BOSA-run catalog indexing federal/regional datasets incl. the CBE/KBO open-data dataset entry and Statbel series; useful discovery index, DCAT metadata.

sources.name: VBO-FEB — Federation of Belgian Enterprises
sources.verdict: Search-verified (sectoral-federations pages indexed, incl. Febelfin's entry). Umbrella federation whose sector-federation list is a map of the Belgian industry-association graph. Homepage not fetched directly.

sources.verdict: The #1 Dutch-language business daily (Mediafin). Site actively blocks our fetcher; its RSS help article is gone (Mediafin zendesk closed), so no feed URL could be verified — plan on headless/partner access. Headline+link only per project copyright rules.

sources.verdict: FSMA publishes news, sector overviews (e.g. annual IORP overview) and fraud/CASP warning lists; individual news URLs are search-indexed and real, but fsma.be resets automated fetches — needs browser-grade crawling.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Global alternatives standard: Belgian GP/fund profiles, performance, and the Belgian LP universe (pension funds, insurers) for fundraising intelligence. Thin on Belgian mid-market service graph and niche alts.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: FSMA AIFM/ManCo lists, NBB supervised-institution lists, FSMA IORP register and annual IORP overviews, fund managers' own annual reports filed at NBB CBSO, press releases — all directly reachable via the tier1/tier2 sources cataloged here.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Belgian PE/VC deals, valuations, listed-holding data (Sofina, GBL, Gimv, Brederode). Strong deal history, weaker on gazette-level entity events.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Euronext Brussels disclosures, company press releases, De Tijd/L'Echo coverage, KBO/CBE identifiers, Staatsblad incorporation/merger publications.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Deepest Belgian startup/scale-up ecosystem coverage; partners with regional agencies for ecosystem dashboards. VC-centric; no private debt/real assets depth.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: KBO/CBE open data, Staatsblad publications, startup press (Bloovi, Made in, Tech.eu), accelerator/association lists (Private Capital Belgium), PMV/regional-investor portfolio pages.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow Belgian startup/funding coverage, crowd-sourced plus press-parsed; weak entity hygiene versus registry-grade data.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases and startup media; no visible registry integration for Belgium — a gap we close by anchoring on KBO + CBSO.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The strongest local benchmark: ownership graphs, directors, and financials across 3M+ Belgian entities with API and data feeds; owned by Mediafin (De Tijd/L'Echo). Company-data centric, not alternatives-taxonomy aware.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Explicitly: KBO/CBE for status/directors, NBB CBSO annual accounts, Belgisch Staatsblad publications, UBO register (as obliged-entity access). All except UBO are directly open to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Free/freemium Belgian company profiles with AI descriptions, real-time updates and sales-intelligence agent; consumer-grade UX, no alternatives focus.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: KBO/CBE, NBB annual accounts, Staatsblad, plus press/social/vacancy scraping — public underlying registers are the same tier1 set we catalog.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Incumbent Belgian credit-information provider (scores, payment behavior, alerts) used widely by finance teams; strong on distress signals.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: KBO/CBE, NBB CBSO financials, RegSol/court insolvency data, Staatsblad publications — the distress layer maps to our tier3 sources.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Credit risk and compliance data on Belgian companies; proprietary payment-experience pool on top of registry data.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: KBO/CBE open data, NBB annual accounts, gazette publications, bankruptcy statistics (Statbel/RegSol-derived).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Directory/rankings of top Belgian companies with financials and sector tops; verified redirect trendstop.be → trendstop.knack.be. B2B prospecting oriented.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: NBB CBSO annual accounts and KBO identifiers, packaged into rankings.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Comprehensive Belgian & Luxembourg financials/ownership product (BvD is Belgian-origin); the institutional standard for BE company financial screening.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: NBB CBSO filings (bulk), KBO/CBE registry, Staatsblad events — again fully public underneath.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Free Belgian monitoring service over gazette publications with company profiles, alerts and a free API tier (100 req/day) — verified by fetch. Proof that Staatsblad+KBO+CBSO can be productized cheaply.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Belgisch Staatsblad Rechtspersonen annex, KBO/CBE, NBB annual accounts.

searchedButAbsent: Searched for but not available/not verifiable: (1) UBO register — exists at FPS Finance but public access was cut after the Nov 2022 CJEU ruling; only obliged entities/authorities; do not plan on open UBO data (matches project rule). (2) No public register of NPL/credit servicers found yet (Credit Servicers Directive register at NBB expected but not located as a published list). (3) No Belgian litigation-funder register — litigation funding is unregulated in BE; coverage must come from press + KBO. (4) No standalone national insolvency-practitioner roll — curators appear per case in RegSol/Staatsblad, not as an open roster. (5) De Tijd RSS feed URLs — Mediafin help center is closed and tijd.be/lecho.be block fetchers; De Tijd feeds could not be confirmed. (6) De Standaard and Le Soir RSS URLs — sites block automated access, feeds unverified. (7) NBB RSS — nbb.be/en/rss returns 404; no working NBB feed found, and NBB press-page path could not be pinned down (three candidate paths 404). (8) FSMA machine access — every fsma.be fetch was reset (ECONNRESET); all FSMA URLs are search-index-verified only and its registers are largely PDFs, so plan a browser-grade fetcher there. (9) Belgian Leasing Association — sits inside Febelfin, no separate verified member directory. (10) RICS Belgium — no country-level public valuer directory; only the global rics.org find-a-member search. (11) Kanaal Z/Canal Z (business TV), Belga News Agency, and De Rijkste Belgen (wealth/holdings tracker) were identified as candidates but omitted because their URLs/feeds were not verified in this session. Web search budget hit its session cap near the end; all included sources rest on direct fetch verification or search-index corroboration as stated per-source.
